inspection_basis: Actual view_image tool inspections followed by decoded RGBA identity comparison for post-build delivery rerenders. Record time is separate from pixel-view clock observation.
observations: All eight full-resolution exact-GLB views were inspected. The closed flattened ovoid has a coherent polygonal raised ridge network on both faces; gray view proves physical relief. Side/top show exactly two opposed short horns on broad faces, below the apex and within the margin, rather than Trapa-like marginal arms. The corrected ridge network avoids jagged material-selected edges, but remains cleaner and more even than the rough fossil concept. Closed ridge segments overlap purposefully at junctions; this is an editable multi-part teaching prop, not a printable single solid. Initial small framing was corrected without metric rescaling.
